metadata.warning: No route or location in this dataset is guaranteed safe. Current verified shelter, flood-zone, cyclone-warning and landslide-warning records for Yangon were not found in the checked public sources.

properties.name: Yangon rain or thunderstorm forecast
properties.description: DMH forecast one or two rain or thundershowers for Yangon and neighbouring area for 18 August 2026. The report also said cumulonimbus clouds were developing in Yangon Region and that strong wind, rain, thunder, lightning and hail may occur along cloud movement. DMH did not publish a categorical severity or a machine-readable forecast footprint.
properties.source: Myanmar Department of Meteorology and Hydrology
properties.license: No open-data license stated on the report; site footer states © 2025 Ministry of National Planning. All rights reserved.
properties.geometry_source: OCHA FISS Myanmar COD-AB, Yangon Region (MMR013)
properties.geometry_note: Administrative coverage envelope only; it is not a meteorological footprint and does not imply identical conditions across the whole region.

properties.name: M 3.5 — 12 km E of Kanbe, Myanmar
properties.description: Reviewed USGS earthquake at 10 km depth with one felt report and no PAGER alert. This was the latest USGS catalog event found inside the OCHA COD Yangon Region polygon for 1 January 2025 through retrieval time. It is a historical event record, not a current warning.
properties.source: U.S. Geological Survey Earthquake Hazards Program
properties.license: U.S. Public Domain; credit to USGS requested.

properties.name: YBS No. 6 bus fire near Sanpya Market
properties.description: A YBS No. 6 bus caught fire on the Pyidaungsu overbridge near Sanpya Market, Thingangyun Township. The report, citing the Fire Services Department, says firefighters extinguished it at 06:57 and no casualties were reported. The source did not publish verified coordinates.
properties.source: Global New Light of Myanmar, citing Myanmar Fire Services Department
properties.license: No open-data license stated; site copyright applies.
properties.location_text: Pyidaungsu overbridge near Sanpya Market, Thingangyun Township, Yangon Region
properties.geometry_missing_reason: Official report provided a textual location but no coordinates; no geocoded estimate was added.
